description: Scanned page from released government records showing two tables of text messages attributed to Andrew McCabe, each row listing his name, Incoming/Outgoing direction, a timestamp, and message text, with some content redacted or struck through. The November 2016 messages discuss packages needing signatures, a Washington Post article about Trump offering Michael Flynn the national security adviser job, and a DAG inquiry about a FISA target. The December 12, 2016 messages quote a Post report that the CIA identified 'actors' who delivered stolen files to WikiLeaks and note that Clapper was meeting Brennan and Cohen for dinner.
text: Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-11-15 19:19:00. 16 packages tomorrow. 4 may come separately because they still need to be signed. Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-11-16 14:32:00. Hey, can you call me on your way back. One flag for the sac svtc. Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-11-16 15:01:00. Never mind. Solved. Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-11-17 20:28:00. An article to share: Trump offers retired Lt. Gen. Michael Flynn the job of national security adviser, a person close to the transition says. Trump offers retired Lt. Gen. Michael Flynn the job of national security adviser, a person close to the transition says. http://wapo.st/2g186WC. Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-11-18 05:39:00. I tried sending an email to [redacted] but it bounced back. Are you still getting the [redacted] emails? DAG inquired about our plan re that FISA target if he mobilizes, given the physical access he has. Let me know if you got the email I forwarded from Tash. Andrew McCabe. Incoming. 2016-12-12 22:16:00. [struck through: This is the piece that I just cannot source.] "U.S. intelligence officials said the CIA has identified the "actors" who took possession of those stolen files and delivered them to WikiLeaks. The individuals are known for their affiliations to Russian intelligence services, but "one step" removed from the Russian government." That is from the Post. Let's confirm tomorrow with CY and CD if they have any idea what this refers to. Andrew McCabe. Outgoing. 2016-12-12 22:33:00. Btw, Clapper told Pete that he (Clapper) was meeting with Brennan and Cohen for dinner tonight. Just FYSA. Andrew McCabe. Incoming. 2016-12-12 22:34:00. OK.
flags: 'Pete', 'Cohen', 'Tash', 'CY', and 'CD' are named/abbreviated in the messages but not confidently identifiable from the image alone
FBI attribution inferred from McCabe's known role; the agency is not named on the page
Message content consists of the participants' claims, not verified facts

description: Movie-poster-style meme titled 'FISAGATE' presenting the FISA/Nunes memo controversy as a film. Against a fiery red sky it arranges portraits of Barack Obama (center), Hillary Clinton, James Comey, Loretta Lynch, and Andrew McCabe. Below the title, five-star 'review' quotes about the memo are attributed to Republican congressmen Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, Matt Gaetz, Steve King, and Scott Perry.
text: FISAGATE. "What I saw is absolutely shocking." Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the scariest of places." Matt Gaetz. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen." Steve King. "As soon as you read the Memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB!?" Scott Perry.
flags: Partisan meme framing the FISA memo as a scandal implicating the pictured officials; the poster's implication of wrongdoing is the meme's claim, not established fact
Quote attributions are the meme's claims, though similar statements by these congressmen were widely reported

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet from October 11, 2012, asking why Barack Obama's ring has an Arabic inscription and linking to a WND article. The link card shows a photo of Obama with his hand on his chin and the headline "Obama's ring: 'There is no god but Allah'" from wnd.com. The WND claim about the ring's inscription was widely debunked; fact-checkers found the ring bears no Arabic text.
text: Log in. Sign up. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Why does Barack Obama's ring have an arabic inscription? bit.ly/VMN6Vn Who is this guy? Obama's ring: 'There is no god but Allah'. wnd.com. 1:11 PM - Oct 11, 2012.
flags: The WND ring-inscription claim promoted in the tweet is debunked; Snopes and others found no Arabic inscription on Obama's ring
